scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,desktop -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @gamecast/server && npm run dev -w @gamecast/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gamecast/server && npm run build -w @gamecast/desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run build -w @gamecast/server && npm run package:win -w @gamecast/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @gamecast/server && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: biome lint apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/electron apps/server/src packages/contracts/src
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
